SCRIPT.KOREAN: 그 50만 원이 뭔데 이런 짓을 해!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: What the hell is that 500 dollar for—doing stuff like this?!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你就为了那两千块钱，做出这种事？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 50萬算什麼，妳竟為了錢做這種事！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: その50万ウォンがなんだってこんなことしてるんだ！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Uang 500 dolar itu buat apaan sih...buat hal beginian?!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: O que você acha que tá fazendo por 500.000 won?!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡¿Qué clase de cosas estás haciendo por 500,000 wones?!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: این 500 دلار برای چیه که اینجوری کار میکنی؟!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Wearing weird clothes and all!!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 還穿著奇怪的衣服！！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 変な服まで着て！！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Pake baju aneh-aneh pula!!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Usando essas roupas estranhas e tudo mais!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Poniéndote ropa extraña y todo!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: پوشیدن لباس های عجیب و غریب و همه چیز!!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Hey, what’s wrong with this outfit?!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 這衣服是哪裡奇怪了！！！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ちょっと この服がなんだっていうの！！！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Hey, emangnya kenapa sama outfit ini?!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: E o que tem de errado com a roupa?!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡¿Qué tiene de malo la ropa?!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: هی، این لباس چه اشکالی دارد؟!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: It doesn’t suit you! It’s weird!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 不適合你！很奇怪！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 似合ってない！変だ！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Nggak cocok di kamu! Aneh!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não fica bem em você. Tá esquisito!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: No te queda bien. ¡Se ve raro!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: به شما نمی خورد! عجیب است!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 야, 네가 이렇게 나 붙잡고 화내는 게 더 이상하거든?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: No, you grabbing me and yelling is weirder, okay?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 喂，你抓着我吼才更奇怪吧？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你對我發脾氣才更奇怪吧？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あんたがわたしを引き留めて怒る方がよっぽど変だよ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Nggak, yang lebih aneh tuh kamu narik-narik aku dan teriak-teriak!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não é mais esquisito você me agarrar pelo braço e gritar comigo?!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡¿No es más raro que me agarres del brazo y me grites?!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: نه، تو مرا می گیری و فریاد می زنی عجیب تر است، خوب؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아무것도 모르면서 말 이상하게 하지 마.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Don’t say weird stuff when you don’t even know what’s going on.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 什么都不知道就别乱说话
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你什麼都不知道，不要隨便亂講話
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 何も知らないくせに変なこと言わないで
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Jangan ngomong aneh kalau kamu aja nggak ngerti apa yang sebenarnya terjadi.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não fala besteira sem saber de nada.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: No digas tonterías si no sabes nada.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: وقتی حتی نمی دانید چه خبره، چیزهای عجیب و غریب نگویید.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 그럼 네가 이 상황을 납득시켜 보든가!!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Then you try to make sense of this situation!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 那你说服我理解这情况啊！！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 那妳就解釋清楚，這是什麼情況！！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: じゃあお前がこの状況を納得させてみろよ！！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kalau gitu, coba kamu jelasin situasi ini!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Então me explica o que é essa situação!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Entonces explícame que es esta situación!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: سپس سعی می کنید این وضعیت را درک کنید!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ah, don’t shout!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 拜託，不要大吼大叫！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 叫ばないでよ！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ah, jangan teriak-teriak dong!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não grita comigo!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡No me grites!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آه، فریاد نزن!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Don’t you shout either!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 妳自己才不要吼叫！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: お前こそ叫ぶな！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kamu juga jangan teriak!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você também tá gritando!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Tú tampoco me grites!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: تو هم فریاد نزن!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Are you going to tell Aunt about this?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 妳媽知道這件事嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: これお前のおばさんも知ってるのか？？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kamu mau bilang ke Tante soal ini ya?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Sua mãe sabe disso?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿Tu madre sabe de esto?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اینو به عمه میگی؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아 갑자기 우리 엄마 얘기가 왜 나와.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Why are you bringing up my mom all of a sudden?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 喂，幹嘛突然扯到我媽
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: いきなり母さんの話どうして出るの
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kenapa tiba-tiba bawa-bawa mamaku sih?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, por que você tá trazendo minha mãe do nada?!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Ah, ¿por qué metes a mi mamá de repente?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: چرا یکدفعه مامانم رو بزرگ میکنی؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 너 내가 이모한테 다 이를 거야.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’m going to tell my aunt everything.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我會把所有事情都告訴阿姨的！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: お前 俺が全部おばさんに言いつけてやるからな
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku bakal bilang semuanya ke Tante.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Vou contar tudo pra ela.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Se lo voy a contar todo a tu mamá.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: من همه چیز را به عمه ام می گویم.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Fine—say it then! Just listen...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 好好好，我說！你給我聽清楚...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ 言うから だからちょっと聞いて…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ya udah, bilang aja! Tapi dengerin dulu…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, eu vou te contar! Mas me escuta primeiro...
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Ya, te voy a contar! Pero escúchame...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: خوب - پس بگو! فقط گوش کن...

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: ...what is it.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 所以...到底是什麼
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: はあ…何
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: ...apa?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Me diz, o que é tudo isso?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Dime, ¿qué es todo esto?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: ... چیه

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Uh...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Uh…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah...
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Ah...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه...

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아, 은비... 은비 유학비가 좀 부족해...!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Eun‑bi’s tuition money is a bit short...!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 恩妃留學的費用不夠...！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ ウンビの留学費がちょっと足りないの…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Uang kuliahnya Eun-bi kurang…!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, é que... eu preciso de dinheiro pra faculdade da Eunbi...!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Es que...necesito dinero para la universidad de Eunbi...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: پول شهریه یون بی کمی کم است...!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 얼마나 부족한데? 그래서 그걸 네가 다 댈 수 있어?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: How short? Are you really planning to cover all of that?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 差多少？你就能全填上吗？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 還差多少？那筆錢是妳負擔得起的嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: どれだけ足りないんだよ それをお前が全部出せるのか？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kurang berapa? Kamu serius mau nanggung semuanya?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Quanto falta? Vai pagar tudo sozinha?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿Cuánto falta? ¿Planeas pagar todo eso tú sola?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: چقدر کوتاه واقعاً قصد دارید همه اینا رو پوشش دهید؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아, 그러니까 지금 렌탈 여친 하고 있는 거 아니야?!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: So that means you’re doing this “rental girlfriend” stuff now?!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 所以我才会来做“租借女友”啊？！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 所以我現在不就是正在做出租女友嗎？！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ、だから今レンタル彼女やってるの！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Jadi itu alasan kamu ngelakuin kerjaan “sewaan pacar” ini sekarang?!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: É por isso que eu trabalho como namorada de aluguel.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Es por eso que trabajo como novia de alquiler
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: پس این بدان معناست که شما اکنون این کار "دوست دختر اجاره ای" را انجام می دهید؟!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아 그냥 여친인 척만 좀 해주면 되는 거라고!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: No, I’m just pretending to be a girlfriend for a little while!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 就只是假装一下女友而已！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 就只是假裝一下女朋友而已！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ただ彼女のふりを少ししてくれればいいだけなんだって
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Nggak, aku cuma pura-pura jadi pacar untuk sementara!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Só finjo ser a namorada dele por um tempo!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Solo finjo ser su novia por un rato!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: نه، من فقط برای مدت کوتاهی وانمود می کنم که دوست دختر هستم!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Stop that.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 妳給我停手
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: お前それやめろ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Berhenti deh.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Para com isso.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Déjate de eso.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: بس کن

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 그렇게 해서 번 돈인 거 알면
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: If Aunt finds out that’s how you made the money,
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 要是让恩妃和你妈知道这钱是这么来的
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 要是知道這錢是怎麼賺來的
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: そんなことして稼いだ金だって知ったら
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kalau Tante tahu kamu dapat uangnya dari cara kayak gitu,
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Se descobrirem como você conseguiu esse dinheiro,
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Si se enteran como obtuviste el dinero
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اگر عمه بفهمد شما از این طریق پول در آورده اید،

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: do you think she’d be happy?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你覺得恩妃和妳媽會高興嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ウンビはおばさんは喜ぶと思うか？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: kamu pikir dia bakal seneng?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: acha que a Eunbi ou sua mãe vão ficar felizes?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿crees que Eunbi o tu mamá van a estar contentas?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: به نظر شما او خوشحال می شود؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 그거 계속할 거면 나 볼 생각 하지 마.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: If you keep doing that, don’t expect me to see you again.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 要继续做这种事就别想着见我了
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 如果你還要繼續，我們就不要再見面了
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: それ続けるなら俺に会おうとするな
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kalau kamu terus kayak gini, jangan harap aku mau ketemu kamu lagi.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Se for continuar com isso, esquece de mim.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Si vas a seguir con eso, olvídate de mí.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اگر به این کار ادامه می دهید، انتظار نداشته باشید که دوباره شما را ببینم.

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ねぇ…！！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Hey…!!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: سلام...!!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Got you—those con artists.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 找到了，你们这两个骗子
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 找到了。這兩個騙子
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 見つけた この詐欺師どもめ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ketangkep juga—penipu kalian.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Achei vocês, malditos golpistas.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Los encontré, malditos estafadores.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: متوجه شدم، اون هنرمندان کلاهبردار.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: You two are in cahoots, aren’t you?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你們兩個是一夥的，對吧？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: お前ら二人 グルだろ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kalian berdua satu komplotan, kan?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Vocês dois são cúmplices, não são?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿Ustedes dos son cómplices, verdad?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: شما دو نفر در جمع هستید، اینطوری نیست؟
